Les actions exécutent des commandes sur: Actions run commands on the server: check their contents before applying.
Les changements effectués ici agissent s: Changes here affect the running service and may be temporary. Use configuration tabs to persist jail settings. A command may interrupt protection or lift bans.
Les changements sont sauvegardés, testés: Changes are backed up, validated and applied. Disabling a jail removes its protection and may lift its bans.
Les preuves techniques filtrées et leur: Filtered technical evidence and its attachment are added automatically. HTTP 401/403 responses alone are insufficient. Saving does not resend old reports.
Les signalements utilisent Postfix direc: Reports use Postfix directly, without a webhook. Checks run every 5 minutes; the daily report runs at 08:00 in the configured timezone. History and duplicate protection are preserved.
Les tests utilisent les réglages enregis: Tests use saved settings. The password stays hidden after saving. Use your usual HTTPS access to enter credentials.
L’application recharge les protections s: The application reloads protections without restarting the container. Manual bans follow each jail's configured duration.

Choisis comment FCP accède à Fail2ban. L: Choose how FCP accesses Fail2ban. Existing rules and bans are preserved.
Les chemins sont ceux accessibles depuis: Paths must be accessible from FCP. When FCP runs in Docker, mount the host configuration, socket and logs into its container. The Fail2ban client must be installed in the FCP environment and compatible with the server.
Les droits du compte FCP sont utilisés,: FCP uses its service account permissions without automatic privilege escalation. Detection and testing do not change Fail2ban.
L’enregistrement vérifie à nouveau la co: Saving tests the connection again. If it fails, the active mode is preserved. Starting and stopping a native Linux service must be done on its host when FCP is containerized. External automations have their own connection and are not moved by this form.

Configuration inaccessible ou droits de: Configuration is inaccessible or write permissions are insufficient.
Les chemins et le socket doivent être ac: Paths and socket must be accessible from the FCP machine or container.
